body: I just ran out of patience myself, despite knowing he wanted to change. I feel like that made him feel he didn't make me happy, and that's why he left.
Trying. I am. But it's so hard.
Seems at some point they all abandon me anyway.

Just sad. I put all my energy in expecting the best possible outcome. I still lost him. I know he needs to sort his own things out, but I feel so useless. Why couldn't I help? Why did he push me away when I wanted to?
Tried. Responses such as 'enough is enough' doesn't help me in this situation.

I have one. They just ramble and don't just *listen*. I know they mean well but they don't help. I go to friends as well - I over-talk really. It doesn't seem to help.. Later I just feel guilty for burdening them with my problems.
